name: Typhoid Mary, Fractured
oracle_text:
Whenever Typhoid Mary attacks, choose one at random. If you discarded a card this turn, you choose one instead.
• Mary — Create a Treasure token.
• Typhoid Mary — Draw a card.
• Bloody Mary — Each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
blocked_sentences: Whenever Typhoid Mary attacks, choose one at random. If you discarded a card this turn, you choose one instead.

needs.what: a choose_mode option (e.g. `random: true`, overridable by a condition such as `random_unless`) that picks the mode uniformly at random from the game's seeded RNG instead of asking the chooser
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_mode takes chooser/count/up_to/once_each/budget but always asks a player via ask_mode; `random` exists only on selectors and discard. roll_dice + if would be an approximation: rolling a die is a distinct game event that 'whenever you roll' cards see, and the card does not roll

needs.what: a per-player turn-ledger value or condition 'you discarded a card this turn' (count of cards the controller discarded this turn), usable as the condition that switches the random pick to a player choice
needs.why_existing_wont_do: value_keys has cards_to_graveyard_this_turn, cards_drawn_this_turn and greatest_discarded_by_a_player but nothing counting discards this turn; cards_to_graveyard_this_turn also counts dies/mills and misses discards to exile under replacement, and has_turn_flag only reads flags written by set_turn_flag
